instruction: Navigate to the Repos page and use the language dropdown to filter repositories by 'Python'. How many repositories use Python?
Go to the detail page for repository ID 1001 (meridianflow-api). What is the default branch of this repository?
Use the search feature to find repositories or activities matching the query 'anomaly'. How many repositories match?
Use the semantic search to find content related to 'workflow automation scaling'. How many repositories are returned?
Use the code search feature to search for 'TaskGroup' across all repositories. In which repository and file is 'TaskGroup' found?
Filter the repository list to show only repositories that use 'TypeScript' in their tech stack. How many repositories use TypeScript?
Sort all repositories by name (alphabetical). What is the name of the first repository in the sorted list?
Search for 'webhook' and report the title of the first matching activity's commit message.
Use semantic search to find activities related to 'rate limit'. What is the merge request title of the top activity result?
Compare repositories 1001 and 1002 using the compare API. Which repository has more commits?
View the detail page for repository ID 1008 (flownet-research). Who is the owner of this repository?

Create a new repository named 'test-project' with description 'A test repository' and visibility set to 'public'. Confirm the repository was created by checking that it appears in the repository list.
Create a new issue on repository 1001 (meridianflow-api) with the title 'Add support for batch workflow deletion' and label it as 'enhancement'. Confirm the issue was created.
Update issue #1 on repository 1001 to change its state from 'open' to 'closed'. Verify the issue state was updated.
Upload a file named 'CHANGELOG.md' with the content 'Initial release' to repository 1001 (meridianflow-api) with the commit message 'Add changelog'. Verify the upload was recorded.
Update the settings for repository 1004 (shared-gateway) to change its visibility from 'private' to 'public' using the settings API. Verify the change took effect.
Export the repository data as JSON using the export API. How many repositories are in the exported data?
Post a comment on issue #1 of repository 1001 (meridianflow-api) with the body 'I can confirm this bug. The global timeout should be enforced at the TaskGroup level.' Verify the comment was posted.
Star repository 1001 (meridianflow-api) using the star toggle API. Verify that the repository is now starred.
Search for code containing 'async def' across all repositories. How many files contain this pattern? List the repository names where matches were found.
